info.title: LBX Partner API
info.description: Market data, opportunities and order placement for LBX partners. Authenticate every request with `Authorization: Bearer <partner key>`. Orders are placed for the partner’s own investor account (nominee model) and go through the same eligibility, signing and settlement flow as the LBX investor app.

schema.description: One or more industry names. Repeat the param for multiple.

parameters.description: One or more industry names. Repeat the param for multiple.
parameters.name: industry

schema.description: true = LBX25 constituents only; false = exclude constituents

parameters.description: true = LBX25 constituents only; false = exclude constituents
parameters.name: inLBX25

get.summary: Company detail with embedded 12-month pricing + activity history
All funding rounds for a company
Daily prices (institutional + retail) for a company
get.description: One point per pricing day, ascending. Filter with `from`/`to` (inclusive, UTC days); `limit` keeps the most recent N days of the range. A company with no daily prices returns an empty series.

schema.description: Most recent N days within the range (1-2000). Default 365.

parameters.description: Most recent N days within the range (1-2000). Default 365.
parameters.name: limit

get.summary: Daily prices for every priced company on one day
get.description: Bulk snapshot: every company that has a price on `date` (default: the latest day with prices). Use this for a daily pull instead of one call per company.

schema.description: Pricing day (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the latest day that has prices.

parameters.description: Pricing day (UTC, YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the latest day that has prices.
parameters.name: date

post.summary: Place an order (returns a one-shot signing URL)
post.description: Places an order for the partner’s investor account against a tokenized opportunity and mints the prospectus signing envelope. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (any string unique per order attempt) to make retries safe: a repeat with the same key returns the original order instead of creating a second one.

200.description: Order created (or the existing order for a repeated Idempotency-Key)

400.description: Validation error (offer closed, minimum, fees unset, …)

403.description: Partner account not eligible (suspended, not accredited, not registered)

get.summary: All orders on the partner account, newest first

post.summary: Confirm the prospectus is signed; advances to awaiting_payment
post.description: Call after the signatory completes the DocuSign envelope. Idempotent. Returns 400 "Documents not signed yet" if called too early — retry after signing.

post.summary: Re-issue the signing URL for an order still awaiting signature

400.description: Not cancellable from its current status

get.summary: The offer’s legal documents (references) for an order
Short-lived download URL for one legal document
Download a settlement document (signed prospectus, receipt)
get.description: Document ids come from the order’s `settlementDocuments` array, populated once the custody platform issues them.

400.description: Order has no custody-side documents yet

get.summary: Holdings (per position + grouped per offer) with live valuation and a summary

date.description: The pricing day served; null when no prices exist yet

returnUrl.description: Where DocuSign sends the signer after signing. Defaults to the LBX web app; partners should pass their own page.
